title: Visa TAP: browsing request verified at the CDN
summary: The Cloudflare sequence for a browsing request: headers present, key fetched by keyid and cached, time window, nonce uniqueness, tag, signature base rebuilt, Ed25519 verification.

steps.label: Signed GET through a Checkout Enabler
steps.detail: The agent may reach the merchant through a Checkout Enabler.

payload.content:
GET /example-product HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225900;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

steps.label: Pass signatures and query parameters through
steps.detail: The only TAP expectation of a Checkout Enabler is to pass signatures and query parameters unchanged.

failures.outcome: Verification fails or the request looks unsigned

steps.label: Headers present
steps.detail: Signature-Input and Signature must both be present.

steps.label: Fetch key by keyid and cache it
steps.detail: The CDN fetches the key from the payment scheme's key store and caches it.

payload.content:
# The JWKS the TAP specification named until October 2026; the current page names no URL,
# and Visa's own code uses this JWKS's one RSA key to encrypt tokens for its MCP server.
GET /.well-known/jwks HTTP/1.1
Host: mcp.visa.com

steps.label: Time window
steps.detail: Now must be between created and expires; TAP also caps the window at 8 minutes.

steps.label: Nonce not seen recently
steps.detail: The CDN keeps recent nonces and rejects a repeat.

steps.label: Tag is agent-browser-auth
steps.detail: A browsing request must carry the browsing tag.

failures.outcome: Block or handle as non-TAP traffic

steps.label: Rebuild signature base and verify Ed25519
steps.detail: The CDN rebuilds the base from the components named in Signature-Input and verifies the signature.

steps.label: Forward, marked as a verified agent
steps.detail: The zone owner can act on the result, for example in Cloudflare Bot Management rules.
